# Yale Medicine

> Yale Medicine provides comprehensive medical information, clinical trials access, and healthcare services across multiple specialties including oncology, gastroenterology, and orthopedics.

Yale Medicine's website serves as both a patient education resource and a clinical information hub, featuring a directory of conditions and departments, access to 668+ clinical trials, and expert-authored health articles. The site emphasizes evidence-based information from Yale Medicine specialists and affiliated centers like Smilow Cancer Hospital.

## Key Topics

- Clinical Trials
- Smilow Cancer Hospital
- Yale Cancer Center
- GLP-1 Medications
- Weight Loss Treatment
- Inflammatory Bowel Disease
- Asthma Management
- Orthopedic Surgery
- Gastrointestinal Health
- Medical Specialties
- Patient Education
- Semaglutide/Tirzepatide
- Axial Spondyloarthritis
- Obesity Definition
- Healthcare Services

## Medical Directory & Services

- [Departments & Collaborative Centers](https://www.yalemedicine.org/departments): Yale Medicine departments, centers, and specialized programs including Smilow Cancer Hospital.
- [Condition Topics](https://www.yalemedicine.org/conditions): Directory of health conditions and medical topics organized by specialty.
- [Clinical Keywords](https://www.yalemedicine.org/clinical-keywords): Medical glossary with clinical term definitions and related Yale Medicine resources.

## Clinical Trials & Research

- [Search Clinical Trials](https://www.yalemedicine.org/clinical-trials): Searchable database of 668+ clinical trials available to Yale Medicine patients.

## Health & Treatment Articles

- [GLP-1 Medications for Weight Loss: How to Get Started](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/glp-1-medications-for-weight-loss-how-to-get-started): Expert guide on GLP-1 medications (Wegovy, Zepbound) for weight loss eligibility.
- [Still Using the Same Rescue Inhaler for Asthma? You Might Have Better Options](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/still-using-the-same-rescue-inhaler-for-asthma-you-might-have-better-options): Yale Medicine asthma specialists discuss modern inhaler treatment options.
- [How Exercises After Knee Replacement Surgery Can Speed Your Recovery](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/how-exercises-after-knee-replacement-surgery-can-speed-your-recovery): Post-surgery exercise guide for knee replacement recovery by Yale Medicine expert.
- [Could Your Back Pain Be From Axial Spondyloarthritis?](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/could-your-back-pain-be-from-axial-spondyloarthritis): Article on axial spondyloarthritis screening tool developed by Yale Medicine.
- [Why Gastrointestinal Problems Often Affect Women Differently](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/why-gastrointestinal-problems-often-affect-women-differently): Expert explanation of gender differences in IBS, IBD, and gastrointestinal health.
- [What Does the 'New' Definition of Obesity Mean to You?](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/what-does-the-new-definition-of-obesity-mean-to-you): Cardiologist explains new obesity definition beyond BMI affecting 75% of adults.
- [Laryngitis: Why You Lose Your Voice and What Helps](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/laryngitis-why-you-lose-your-voice-and-what-helps): Medical explanation of laryngitis causes, treatments, and when to seek care.

## News & Resources

- [News Hub](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news): Yale Medicine news hub featuring health articles, research, and patient stories.
